budget_items.topic: Council on Aging FY17 recommended budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager's recommended FY17 COA budget is $111,945, a $735 (0.66%) increase over FY16 after recap; no reduction in services.
budget_items.quote: the town manager's recommended fy17 budget of $111,945 represents a $735 increase, 0.66%, more than fy16 after recap.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY17 COA budget detail spreadsheet shows a FY17 budget target total of $111,945.00 against a FY16 budget of $111,210.00.
COA requests $399.52 be placed in the programs line, funded by savings from the mileage line decrease.
budget_items.quote: requesting that $399.52 be placed into the program line.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY16 Montachusett Opportunity Council yearly donation request decreased to $200.
budget_items.quote: fy16 montachusett opportunity council yearly donation request has decreased to $200.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mileage for MOW drivers changed from a $15 stipend per delivery to $11.50 per week as of 1/1/16.
budget_items.quote: as of 1/1/16 the mileage for mow (meals on wheels) drivers was decreased from a $15 stipend each time a delivery was made to $11.50 per week.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: COA received $18,954.00 in Formula Grant funding in FY16, up from $8 to $9 per elder.
budget_items.quote: in fy16 we received $18,954.00 in formula grant funding. this was an increase from $8 to $9 per elder.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The COA Formula Grant Budget for FY16 lists $2240 from the Formula Grant and $4000 from the Town, with page subtotals and a total printed as $18,954.
A $3,000 Greater Lowell Community Foundation grant applied for in October to reinstate RUOK was approved for full funding.
budget_items.quote: a greater lowell community foundation grant in the amount of $3,000 was applied for in october to reinstate the ruok
